chunks.l2:
[tsa-a13-v01] Now the glad-hearted should go to the worship-place; for wherever the heart is gladdened and made fit for absorption into the Lord, there it becomes — that alone is the mark, nothing else; for even in the saying, meditated identity alone is the cause, and that too is from being-glad alone — nothing else is the place.

[tsa-a13-v10] For here, for firmness of realization of non-difference with the Lord, the worship-act is made the example: there, of all factors, thus is Lord-ness — there, from the sacrificer's place-purity-bringing-doings, from vessel-purity, from placing, from the sacrificer's body-placing, from the worshippable's altar-placing.

[tsa-a13-v11] Thus, even by rite-order alone, making all factors the Lord's, seeing all rites with just this view, without chief knowledge and yoga — one becomes the Supreme Lord.

[tsa-a13-v12] Thus, having placed on the vessel, having worshipped with flowers, smoke and the rest, one should sprinkle the rite-essence and the flowers and the rest with its drops.

[tsa-a13-v13] Then in the halo-circle, on ground or in sky: oṃ to the outer retinue, hail — thus one should worship.

[tsa-a13-v14] Then at the door-place: oṃ to the door-deity-wheel, hail — thus one should worship.

[tsa-a13-v15] But when there is an unguarded outer place, having entered, on the maṇḍala-altar-front alone one should do the outer-retinue-door-deity-wheel worship, the aforesaid placing and the rest — not outside.

[tsa-a13-v16] Then too: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ — thus, having thrown the weapon-muttered flower, having removed the obstacles, having meditated, having entered within, with gaze kindled by the Lord's ray, one should see all around the worship-house.

[tsa-a13-v17] There the release-seeker should stand facing north, so that by the Lord's Aghora-radiance swiftly indeed, his bonds burnt, he may become.

[tsa-a13-v18] There the Lord's freedom alone, by form-shining, shines forth the direction-principle.

[tsa-a13-v19] There awareness-light alone is the middle; thence, other-division arising: what is taken as light is above, what is not thus is below; what faces the light is east, the other is west; from having become facing-light, the next is that-light-stream-rise-place; south from favour, facing it, but from to-be-shone, north — thus the direction-four.

[tsa-a13-v02] But seat, mountain-top and the rest in scripture is to be understood as aimed at pointing out this place.

[tsa-a13-v03] In these seats and the rest, by the Lord's ordainment, powers entered by the Lord take body — like noble lands for the pious, like barbarian lands for the impious; the teaching of the mountain-top, through solitude, from distraction-avoidance, is the state of one-pointedness — thus.

[tsa-a13-v04] There, before the worship-house, outside alone, one should do the general placing — first on the hands, then on the body.

[tsa-a13-v05] hrīṃ na pha hrīṃ, hrīṃ ā kṣa hrīṃ — thus; by these two, expressing power and the power-bearer, the two Mālinī-alphabet mantras; with each one singly — first power, then the power-bearer — in release from foot-tip to head-end; in enjoyment everything is reversed.

[tsa-a13-v06] For Mālinī the Goddess is the chief Śākta form, milking all wishes through the collision of seed and womb.

[tsa-a13-v07] And meaningful is this name: garlanded with Rudra-power garlands, flowered in fruits, the bee of the sound that dissolves the winter of transmigration, holding attainment and release, endowed with the power to give and to withhold — since ra and la are remembered as one.

[tsa-a13-v08] Hence very, for even a broken-rite mantra becomes complete through this placing; even a stained one — Gāruḍa, Vaiṣṇava and the rest — having reached stainlessness, becomes release-giving.

[tsa-a13-v09] After the body-placing, this same placing is to be done on the vessel.
chunks.sanskrit: tantrasāra, trayodaśam āhnikam atha prasannahṛdayo yāgasthānaṃ yāyāt tac ca yatraiva hṛdayaṃ prasādayuktaṃ parameśvarasamāveśayogyaṃ bhavati tad eva na tu asya anyal lakṣaṇam uktāv api dhyeyatādātmyam eva kāraṇam tad api bhāvaprasādād eva iti nānyat sthānam // abhts_13.1 pīṭhaparvatāgram ityādis tu śāstre sthānoddeśa etatpara eva boddhavyaḥ // abhts_13.2 teṣu teṣu pīṭhādisthāneṣu parameśaniyatyā parameśvarāviṣṭānāṃ śaktīnāṃ dehagrahaṇāt āryadeśā iva dhārmikāṇāṃ mlecchadeśā iva adhārmikāṇām parvatāgrādeś caikāntatvena vikṣepaparihārāt aikāgryapadatvam iti // abhts_13.3 tatra yāgagṛhāgre bahir eva sāmānyanyāsaṃ kuryāt karayoḥ pūrvaṃ tato dehe // abhts_13.4 hrīṃ na pha hrīṃ hrīṃ ā kṣa hrīṃ ity ābhyāṃ śaktiśaktimadvācakābhyāṃ mālinīśabdarāśimantrābhyām ekenaiva ādau śaktiḥ tataḥ śaktimān iti muktau pādāgrāc chiro'ntam bhuktau tu sarvo viparyayaḥ // abhts_13.5 mālinī hi bhagavatī mukhyam śāktaṃ rūpaṃ bījayonisaṃghaṭṭena samastakāmadugham // abhts_13.6 anvarthaṃ caitan nāma rudraśaktimālābhir yuktā phaleṣu puṣpitā saṃsāraśiśirasaṃhāranādabhramarī siddhimokṣadhāriṇī dānādānaśaktiyuktā iti ralayor ekatvasmṛteḥ // abhts_13.7 ata eva hi bhraṣṭavidhir api mantra etannyāsāt pūrṇo bhavati sāñjano 'pi gāruḍavaiṣṇavādir nirañjanatām etya mokṣaprado bhavati // abhts_13.8 dehanyāsānantaram arghapātre ayam eva nyāsaḥ // abhts_13.9 iha hi kriyākārakāṇāṃ parameśvarābhedapratipattidārḍhyasiddhaye pūjākriyā udāharaṇīkṛtā tatra ca sarvakārakāṇām itthaṃ parameśvarībhāvaḥ tatra yaṣṭrādhārasya sthānaśuddhyāpādānakaraṇayor arghapātraśuddhinyāsābhyām yaṣṭur dehanyāsāt yājyasya sthaṇḍilādinyāsāt // abhts_13.10 evaṃ kriyākrameṇāpi parameśvarīkṛtasamastakārakaḥ tayaiva dṛśā sarvakriyāḥ paśyan vināpi pramukhajñānayogābhyāṃ parameśvara eva bhavati // abhts_13.11 evam arghapātre nyasya puṣpadhūpādyaiḥ pūjayitvā tadvipruḍbhir yāgasāraṃ puṣpādi ca prokṣayet // abhts_13.12 tataḥ prabhāmaṇḍale bhūmau khe vā oṃ bāhyaparivārāya nama iti pūjayet // abhts_13.13 tato dvārasthāne oṃ dvāradevatācakrāya nama iti pūjayet // abhts_13.14 agupte tu bahiḥsthāne sati praviśya maṇḍalasthaṇḍilāgra eva bāhyaparivāradvāradevatācakrapūjāṃ pūrvoktaṃ ca nyāsādi kuryāt na bahiḥ // abhts_13.15 tato 'pi phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ iti astrajaptapuṣpaṃ prakṣipya vighnān apasāritān dhyātvā antaḥ praviśya parameśvarakiraṇeddhayā dṛṣṭyā abhito yāgagṛhaṃ paśyet // abhts_13.16 tatra mumukṣur uttarābhimukhas tiṣṭhet yathā bhagavadaghoratejasā jhaṭity eva pruṣṭapāśo bhavet // abhts_13.17 tatra parameśvarasvātantryam eva mūrtyābhāsanayā diktattvam avabhāsayati // abhts_13.18 tatra citprakāśa eva madhyaṃ tata itarapravibhāgapravṛtteḥ prakāśasvīkāryam ūrdhvam atathābhūtam adhaḥ prakāśanasammukhīnaṃ pūrvam itarat aparam saṃmukhībhūtaprakāśatvāt anantaraṃ tatprakāśadhārārohasthānaṃ dakṣiṇam ānukūlyāt tatsammukhaṃ tu avabhāsyatvāt uttaram iti dikcatuṣkam // abhts_13.19

chunks.l2:
[tsa-a13-v20] There in the middle the Lord; above, his is the north-eastern face; below, the underworld face; in the east-and-rest four directions, the so-called Tatpuruṣa, Aghora, Sadyas, Vāma; in the four-direction-middle, the other four.

[tsa-a13-v21] Thus indeed awareness-glory alone, formed, shines forth direction-difference — thus direction is not another principle.

[tsa-a13-v22] As, as the shadow is to be overstepped — being, before, before, it becomes — so reaching the Lord's centrality: being all-presiding alone is centrality — thus it is said.

[tsa-a13-v23] Thus as the Lord is the divider of directions, so the sun — for it indeed is the Lord's knowledge-power, thus said: there, there, there the east is of the manifest from the east; and just where, so there — thus self-ruled even, facing one's own place, is in front.

[tsa-a13-v24] Thus by self-sun-Lord-triad-unification is direction-discussion — thus Abhinavagupta's gurus.

[tsa-a13-v25] Thus standing, facing north one should sit, burning body-ness in body-city-eight and the rest by I-feeling abandonment; from nearness as another's body, from bodilessness — then mounted on the waveless steady abode, from gaze-nature — which indeed is the first throb-digit — that alone is the form; thereupon is the as-taught worshippable-deity-wheel-placing; chiefly too here the powers are to be worshipped.

[tsa-a13-v26] From being that seat, of the Lord-nine-self and the rest, of power alone and of worship-worthiness — thus the gurus.

[tsa-a13-v27] There five states: waking and the rest; and sixth called unsurpassed, nature-state to be contemplated.

[tsa-a13-v28] Thus sixfold is the placing.

[tsa-a13-v29] There from the presiding of causes, Brahmā-Viṣṇu-Rudra-Īśa-Sadāśiva-power-formed, each from thirty-six-principle-group, world-transcended in Bhairava-Lord-non-difference-course placing, from fullness is Bhairavī-being; hence this has no opening.

[tsa-a13-v30] Which, they said: gained in waveless mounting, again what with principle-emission through placing and the rest — thus.

[tsa-a13-v31] So long indeed that waveless Bhairava-formed, which in own self shows emission-dissolution-variety-peak.

[tsa-a13-v32] Thus by mutual-meeting-yoga, Lord-made breath-body-mind contemplated, outside and within with flowers-smoke-satings as possible, one should worship.

[tsa-a13-v33] There in the body, in breath, in mind accordingly one should do the trident-lotus-placing — as at base-power-root: root, bulb, to-root-pith, at the hanging-end, to kalā-principle's end the staff; Māyā-natured knot; four-natured pure-knowledge lotus; right there the Lord Sadāśiva; he alone the great corpse; through excellence dissolved, from awakening, chiefly, from knowable-bodied body-decay, and from sound-touch-awareness-nature.

[tsa-a13-v34] That risen from the navel, come out of the three head-openings at its top, abiding inside sound, power-pervader, equanimity-formed and the rest, the six-end; thereupon is the pure lotus-triad, beyond-mind; on this universe-made division made seat, presiding as pervading-being, the desired become-supported deity having fashioned — which right there, in same-disposition-full self, universe-being-offering: that alone is worship; which alone becoming-that: that is meditation; which inner-deliberation-being-shaking as of such: that is murmur; which by such-deliberation-order-awakened great-splendour, by that force alone, is universe-self-making: that is oblation; that very thing done thus, the retinue, from that alone, like sparks from a fire-heap, having meditated, just so one should worship.
chunks.sanskrit: tatra madhye bhagavān ūrdhve 'sya aiśānaṃ vaktram adhaḥ pātālavaktram pūrvādidikcatuṣke śrītatpuruṣāghorasadyovāmākhyaṃ dikcatuṣkamadhye anyāś catasraḥ // abhts_13.20 ity evaṃ saṃvinmahimaiva mūrtikṛtaṃ digbhedaṃ bhāsayati iti dik na tattvāntaram // abhts_13.21 yathā yathā ca svacchāyā laṅghayitum iṣṭā satī puraḥ puro bhavati tathā parameśvaramadhyatām eti sarvādhiṣṭhātṛtaiva mādhyasthyam ity uktam // abhts_13.22 evaṃ yathā bhagavān digvibhāgakārī tathā sūryo 'pi sa hi pārameśvary eva jñānaśaktir ity uktaṃ tatra tatra tatra pūrvaṃ vyakteḥ pūrvā yatraiva ca tathā tatraiva evaṃ svātmādhīnāpi svasammukhīnasya deśasya purastāttvāt // abhts_13.23 evaṃ svātmasūryaparameśatritayaikībhāvanayā dikcarcā iti abhinavaguptaguravaḥ // abhts_13.24 evaṃ sthite uttarābhimukham upaviśya dehapuryaṣṭakādau ahambhāvatyāgena dehatāṃ dahet saṃnidhāv api paradehavat adehatvāt tato nistaraṅgadhruvadhāmarūḍhasya dṛṣṭisvābhāvyāt yā kila ādyā spandakalā saiva mūrtiḥ tadupari yathopadiṣṭayājyadevatācakranyāsaḥ prādhānyena ca iha śaktayo yājyāḥ // abhts_13.25 tadāsanatvāt bhagavannavātmādīnāṃ śakter eva ca pūjyatvāt iti guravaḥ // abhts_13.26 tatra ca pañca avasthā jāgradādyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī ca anuttarā nāma svabhāvadaśā anusaṃdheyā // abhts_13.27 iti ṣoḍhā nyāso bhavati // abhts_13.28 tatra kāraṇānāṃ brahmaviṣṇurudreśasadāśivaśaktirūpāṇāṃ pratyekam adhiṣṭhānāt ṣaṭtriṃśattattvakalāpasya laukikatattvottīrṇasya bhairavabhaṭṭārakābhedavṛtte nyāse pūrṇatvāt bhairavībhāvaḥ tena etat anavakāśam // abhts_13.29 yad āhuḥ ataraṅgarūḍhau labdhāyāṃ punaḥ kiṃ tattvasṛṣṭir nyāsādinā iti // abhts_13.30 tāvat hi tad ataraṅgaṃ bhairavavapuḥ yat svātmani avabhāsitasṛṣṭisaṃhārāvaicitryakoṭi // abhts_13.31 evam anyonyamelakayogena parameśvarībhūtaṃ prāṇadehabuddhyādi bhāvayitvā bahir antaḥ puṣpadhūpatarpaṇādyair yathāsambhavaṃ pūjayet // abhts_13.32 tatra śarīre prāṇe dhiyi ca tadanusāreṇa śūlābjanyāsaṃ kuryāt tad yathā ādhāraśaktimūle mūlaṃ kanda āmūlasārakaṃ lambikānte kalātattvānto daṇḍaḥ māyātmako granthiḥ catuṣkikātmā śuddhavidyāpadmaṃ tatraiva sadāśivabhaṭṭārakaḥ sa eva mahāpretaḥ prakarṣeṇa līnatvāt bodhāt prādhānyena vedyātmakadehakṣayāt nādāmarśātmakatvāc ca iti // abhts_13.33 tan nābhyutthitaṃ tanmūrdharandhratrayanirgataṃ nādāntarvartiśaktivyāpinīsamanārūpamarātrayaṃ dviṣaṭkāntaṃ tadupari śuddhapadmatrayam aunmanasam etasmin viśvamaye bhede āsanīkṛte adhiṣṭhātṛtayā vyāpakabhāvena ādheyabhūtāṃ yathābhimatāṃ devatāṃ kalpayitvā yat tatraiva samasvabhāvanirbharātmani viśvabhāvārpaṇaṃ tad eva pūjanaṃ yad eva tanmayībhavanaṃ tad dhyānaṃ yat tathāvidhāntaḥparāmarśasadbhāvanādāndolanaṃ sa japaḥ yat tathāvidhaparāmarśakramaprabuddhamahātejasā tathābalād eva viśvātmīkaraṇaṃ sa homaḥ tad evaṃ kṛtvā parivāraṃ tata eva vahnirāśer visphuliṅgavat dhyātvā tathaiva pūjayet // abhts_13.34

chunks.l2:
[tsa-a13-v35] Remembering the twelve-end, this foremost trident, from the root.

[tsa-a13-v36] Leaving sequence, going to goddess-wheel-front attains sky-going-ness.

[tsa-a13-v37] From root-support, of twice-six-end-sky-peak-filling nature.

[tsa-a13-v38] Of sky-going-ness, from sky-faring-rest and from sky-nectar-eating.

[tsa-a13-v39] Thus by inner rite alone, in reality, done-what-was-to-be-done.

[tsa-a13-v40] Truly for the then-entered, still outer is to be done, to remove limitation alone — and who too thus does not partake immersion: his chief is the outer rite; from its practice, immersion-gain; since for him too, but the beast-veiling inner rite, when mounted on that too, of his thought-force is purity-giving.

[tsa-a13-v41] Now when one wishes to do initiation, then for preparation: ground-taking, Gaṇeśa-worship, jar-and-vessel worship, altar-worship, oblation — one should do.

[tsa-a13-v42] But in daily-and-occasional: altar-and-rest worship-oblation alone.

[tsa-a13-v43] There is initiation-preparation, the disciple's refined-fitness-placing, like sharpening of teeth; the God's toward-work-upturned-ness-grasping, the guru's taking of that.

[tsa-a13-v44] Of implement-things, by being inside the worship-house, through the Lord's radiance-swelling, is bestowing of worship-implement-fitness — thus.

[tsa-a13-v45] There, having arranged the worship-house full of all implements, having remembered the Goddess Mālinī or Mātṛkā, bearing the taken, full of her-letter-radiance-mass, one should cast the flower-handful.

[tsa-a13-v46] Then the stated weapon-muttered mustard-grain-parched-rice and the rest, radiance-formed, having scattered, in the north-east direction gathering in order — thus is ground-taking.

[tsa-a13-v47] Then having given the seat up to pure-knowledge's end, Gaṇeśa's worship; then having filled the jar, filled with bliss-substance, adorned, one should worship; then the worshippable next, having placed betel, there the chief mantra, as all-presiding, remembering with rule-precedence, with that 108-times-muttered, that jar one should make.

[tsa-a13-v48] In the second vessel, weapons for obstacle-quelling one should worship.

[tsa-a13-v49] Then in own directions the world-guardians with weapons one should worship.

[tsa-a13-v50] Then to the previously-initiated disciple's hand one should give the weapon-vessel.

[tsa-a13-v51] And oneself the guru should take the jar.

[tsa-a13-v52] Then making the disciple pour the stream around the house for obstacle-quelling, with jar the guru should follow, reciting this mantra: O O Indra! by you in your own direction for obstacle-pacifying.

[tsa-a13-v53] With attentiveness, to be done to rite's end, by Śiva's command.

[tsa-a13-v54] In the three-syllabled name, 'bho' is one alone — thus.

[tsa-a13-v55] Then in the north-east direction one should place the jar.

[tsa-a13-v56] Upon the scattered, the weapon-vessel.

[tsa-a13-v58] Then in the altar-middle Supreme-worship.

[tsa-a13-v59] Then the fire-pit as Supreme-power-formed having contemplated, fire having kindled there, with heart-inner-awakening-fire made one, with mantra-deliberation-accompaniment, the blazing Śiva-fire having contemplated, placed there, having worshipped, one should sate the mantras with ghee and sesame.

[tsa-a13-v60] And with the vessel, sprinkling alone is sesame-ghee and the rest's refining.

[tsa-a13-v61] And of ladle-and-spoon, non-difference-view alone indeed is refining.

śuddhavidyāntam āsanaṃ dattvā gaṇapateḥ pūjā tataḥ kumbham ānandadravyapūritam alaṃkṛtaṃ pūjayet tato yājyam anu pūgaṃ nyasya tatra mukhyaṃ mantraṃ sarvādhiṣṭhātṛtayā vidhipūrvakatvena smaran aṣṭottaraśatamantritaṃ tena taṃ kumbhaṃ kuryāt // abhts_13.47 dvitīyakalaśe vighnaśamanāya astraṃ yajet // abhts_13.48 tataḥ svasvadikṣu lokapālān sāstrān pūjayet // abhts_13.49 tataḥ śiṣyasya prāk dīkṣitasya haste astrakalaśaṃ dadyāt // abhts_13.50 svayaṃ ca guruḥ kumbham ādadīta // abhts_13.51 tataḥ śiṣyaṃ gṛhaparyanteṣu vighnaśamanāya dhārāṃ pātayantaṃ sakumbho 'nugacchet imaṃ mantraṃ paṭhan sthāpayet // abhts_13.55 vikiropari astrakalaśam // abhts_13.56 tata ubhayapūjanam // abhts_13.57 tataḥ sthaṇḍilamadhye parameśapūjanam // abhts_13.58 tataḥ agnikuṇḍaṃ parameśvaraśaktirūpatayā bhāvayitvā tatra agniṃ prajvālya hṛdayāntarbodhāgninā saha ekīkṛtya mantraparāmarśasāhityena jvalantaṃ śivāgniṃ bhāvayitvā tatra nyasya abhyarcya mantrān tarpayet ājyena tilaiś ca // abhts_13.59 arghapātreṇa ca prokṣaṇam eva tilājyādīnāṃ saṃskāraḥ // abhts_13.60 sruksruvayoś ca parameśābhedadṛṣṭir eva hi saṃskāraḥ // abhts_13.61

chunks.l2:
[tsa-a13-v100] In mantra-practice, daily worship, hearing, study, one is entitled; but in the occasional, everywhere the guru alone one should request.

[tsa-a13-v62] Then having offered as able, having arranged ladle-spoon up-down-facing as power-Śiva-formed, mutually facing, having stood even-footed, contemplating the stream of supreme nectar fallen, risen in the sky of the twelve-end, risen full-Śiva-moon, and uttering the vauṣaḍ-ending mantra, until ghee's end one should stand — thus is full oblation, mantra-wheel-sating.

[tsa-a13-v63] Then the sprinkled caru having brought, on altar-vessel-jar-fires share by share having offered, one share having left over, to the disciple one should give a share.

[tsa-a13-v65] Its falling in fire-Yama-Nirṛti directions and below is not auspicious — thus.

[tsa-a13-v66] There oblation by weapon-mantra is to be done.

[tsa-a13-v67] Then for distraction-avoidance, for fitness to see the future mantra, having brought in the blindfolded disciple, having made him kneeling, one should have him cast a flower-handful.

[tsa-a13-v68] Then suddenly, unfastened-eye-bound, through descent-graced instrument-ness, seeing the present mantra in that place face-to-face, he becomes made of that; of graced instruments mantra-nearness is visible, since as it were of trembling beings.

[tsa-a13-v69] Then in one's own right hand with blazing, having worshipped the deity-wheel, placing it burning the disciple's bonds on head-heart-navel.

[tsa-a13-v70] Then in the left with gentleness, having worshipped, fattening with pure principle — then one should bow.

[tsa-a13-v71] Then the being-deity-direction-offering, full of wine-meat-water and the rest, outside one should give, having sipped.

[tsa-a13-v72] Then oneself having eaten the oblation-meal, with disciple-self attaining oneness, awakened-natured one should stay.

[tsa-a13-v73] Dreaming too, at dawn if the disciple tells an inauspicious dream — that to him one should not explain.

[tsa-a13-v74] For doubt and fear would be his; merely with the weapon one should make its expiation.

[tsa-a13-v75] Then just so having worshipped the Lord, entered before him by the disciple's breath-course, touching the six-cause-touching in heart-throat-palate-brow-cleft-twelve-ends, each eight refinements contemplating, some time resting the disciple-breath right there, again one should descend.

[tsa-a13-v76] Thus effected-forty-eight-refinements-upon-made-Rudra-part-attainment becomes a samayin.

[tsa-a13-v77] Then to him the worshippable mantra with flowers and the rest one should bestow.

[tsa-a13-v78] Then the rules to him one should lay down.

[tsa-a13-v79] In the guru with whole self, devotion; so in scripture; in God; aversion toward their opponents; like the guru, of the guru's son and the rest; of the knowledge-tied made, of the before-initiated and the rest, seeing; of the womb-tie, for its honouring, not by oneself — thus to be deemed.

[tsa-a13-v80] Of women, of the barren that-loathing-cause one should not do.

[tsa-a13-v81] Deity-name, guru-name, and mantra, apart from worship-time one should not utter.

[tsa-a13-v82] What the guru has enjoyed — bed and the rest — one should not enjoy.

[tsa-a13-v83] What games and the rest are worldly, that in the guru's nearness one should not do.

[tsa-a13-v84] Apart from that, elsewhere one should not make excellence-thought.

[tsa-a13-v85] Everywhere, in śrāddha and the rest, the guru alone one should worship.

[tsa-a13-v86] And in all occasionals, śākinī-and-the-rest words one should not say.

[tsa-a13-v88] With those of lower sight, Vaiṣṇavas and the rest, company one should not make.

[tsa-a13-v89] Abiding in this teaching, one should not see with former-birth thought.

[tsa-a13-v90] When the guru's circle has come home, as able one should do worship.

[tsa-a13-v91] A lower-path abider, a Vaiṣṇava and the rest, having even made him guru, from his teaching-clan one should abandon.

[tsa-a13-v92] Even then one should not see with excellence-thought.

[tsa-a13-v93] With mark-bearers no conduct-meeting one should make; them only as able one should worship.

[tsa-a13-v95] In the wheel, standing, of last-and-first division, birth-made, one should not fancy.

[tsa-a13-v96] Apart from the body, no other abode-ford and the rest with high regard one should see.

[tsa-a13-v97] Constantly one should remember the mantra-heart — thus the disciple, having heard, having bowed, having accepted, the guru with wealth-wife-body-up-to gift pleasing, and the before-initiated and poor-lordless and the rest sating.

[tsa-a13-v98] And with the future rule, the image-wheel one should sate.

[tsa-a13-v99] Thus one becomes a samayin.

evāpāditāṣṭācatvāriṃśatsaṃskāroparikṛtarudrāṃśāpattiḥ samayībhavati // abhts_13.76 tataḥ asmai pūjyaṃ mantraṃ puṣpādyaiḥ saha arpayet // abhts_13.77 tataḥ samayān asmai nirūpayet // abhts_13.78 gurau
